Congratulations, that's wonderful news! Before we change anything, talk with your doctor or midwife about training. Their clearance comes first, and they'll know what's right for you and how it should shift over the coming months. I'm not going to make changes to your plan until you've had that conversation.

Once you've got their go-ahead, tell me what they said, including anything they want you to avoid, and I'll build around it. Until then, keep it simple and ask them directly what they're comfortable with you doing.
